subtitle: Accommodation facilities in the Serracapriola area.
how_to_reach_text: Serracapriola is located in the province of Foggia, in the Dauno Subapennine, on the border between Puglia and Molise.
how_to_reach_car_north: From the North (Pescara/Termoli): A14 Adriatic motorway to the Poggio Imperiale exit, then SS16 southbound to Serracapriola (about 10 minutes).
how_to_reach_car_south: From the South (Foggia/Bari): A14 to Foggia Nord, then SS16 northbound towards Lesina–Termoli to the Serracapriola exit.
how_to_reach_train_text: Serracapriola-Chieuti station, on the Adriatic Foggia–Termoli line (Trenitalia). The historic centre is about 4 km from the station, reachable by taxi or private transfer on request.
how_to_reach_plane_text: Foggia "Gino Lisa" Airport (~50 km) · Pescara Airport (~120 km) · Bari "Karol Wojtyla" Airport (~160 km). A car rental is recommended from all airports.
how_to_reach_parking_text: Free parking is available near the historic centre and the main accommodation facilities. We recommend contacting the facility before arrival for precise directions.
gonzaga_desc: Elegant residence in the historic centre, immersed in the atmosphere of the medieval village. Ideal for those walking the transhumance routes.
raggio_desc: B&B on the main street of town, in the heart of the village. Warm and welcoming family atmosphere.
terrazza_desc: Overlooking the main street, it offers a splendid terrace with views of the Tavoliere landscape.
dimora_desc: Guest house in the historic centre near Castello Maresca. Apartments with kitchen and air conditioning.
magiolo_desc: Family-run B&B with excellent reviews (9.8/10 on Booking). Free parking, air conditioning, equipped kitchen.
